name: Draft Weekly Report from Jira/Notion
description: Synthesize fragmented Jira ticket updates, GitHub PR milestones, and Notion status notes into a cohesive, structured weekly status report formatted for management and cross-functional stakeholders.

inputs.completed_issues: Bullet points or ticket IDs of tasks completed during this sprint cycle
inputs.in_progress_tasks: Active tasks, code reviews, and WIP milestones currently underway
inputs.blockers: Technical hurdles, dependency wait times, or infrastructure issues impeding velocity
inputs.team_name: Name of team or business domain

outputs.executive_brief: Executive elevator summary of weekly sprint velocity, major ship milestones, and team momentum
outputs.key_highlights: Grouped list of delivered achievements and user-facing value additions
outputs.risk_analysis: Assessment of current blockers with recommended mitigation strategies
outputs.next_week_commitments: Core commitments scheduled for the upcoming weekly cycle

sample_inputs.completed_issues:
- [ENG-402] Shipped FastMCP server with stdio transport
- [ENG-415] Completed DSPy dynamic router failover integration
- [ENG-418] Fixed llama-server health-check timeout on IPv6
sample_inputs.in_progress_tasks:
- [ENG-422] ChromaDB persistent metadata indexing for agent blueprints
- [ENG-430] OpenClaw skill templates drag-and-drop studio UI
sample_inputs.blockers:
- GPU memory quota pending approval for 70B model evaluation cluster
- Awaiting external API rate limit increase from Anthropic
